abilities.name: Disarming Shot
abilities.description: The attack inflicts 1 less damage, but your foe drops something they are holding in one hand (such as a weapon or shield). To retrieve the object, the foe must use an action.

abilities.name: Audacious Blast GM intrusions
abilities.description: Your blaster runs out of power. Your blaster shot ricochets, hitting you or an ally for a moderate wound. The attack draws the attention of other hostiles.

abilities.name: Cypher Use
abilities.description: You can bear one additional cypher at a time.

abilities.name: Redline Maneuver GM intrusions
abilities.description: The FTL engines fail. The ship takes significant damage. Someone’s console within the ship explodes, inflicting a moderate wound.

system.description:
A Space Opera Type focused on starpilot archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Science Fiction. Subgenre: Space Opera. Primary Pools: speed, intellect.
